column7: the same session-liveness chokepoint closes the ADR-039-documented cross-replica cache-staleness bound (a revoke on one replica leaving the session live on another for up to validTokenTTL) down to the next request, since SessionLiveForToken re-reads from the same shared DB every replica already writes to; two cores sharing one DB, only one with the cache invalidator wired, prove a replica that never heard about a sibling's revoke still denies on its next cache hit; see docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-session-revoke-cache-race.md
